Eliot Tran: hi all! i'm Eliot — joining as infra eng (remote-BER). badge didn't arrive but i'm here and very excited :wave: love succulents, board games, and terrible puns. lunch preferences: vegetarian. where do folks grab coffee around the office? also is there a plant swap? :seedling:

Casey Li: hey Eliot — welcome! badge mailed, should arrive tomorrow. coffee: 'blue-kettle' on 3rd floor or the espresso by kitchen. plant swap monthly on third Thursdays. DM me for onboarding checklist. :tada:

Maya Chen: welcome!! bring your succulents to next swap. also game night friday at 7pm in common room. :board_game:

Jordan Patel: if you need temporary badge access, ping Facilities or run `badge-request temporary --name Eliot` (that's internal CLI). also we have a small succulent corner in the east wing. :thumbsup:

welcome-bot: Eliot Tran added to #dev-chat, #infra, #game-night. Onboarding checklist posted: https://redwood.example/onboarding/eliot

Alex (Facilities): Sent you a temporary QR in DM. Office coffee is free, but tip jars appreciated. :coffee:

Eliot Tran: amazing, thanks! i'll bring snacks friday (vegan brownies). also quick q: anyone commute from Kreuzberg? looking for bike route recs. :biking_man:

Maya Chen: i do! bike lanes along Maybachufer are great — watch out near the canal on weekends. :bike:

Jordan Patel: :thumbsup: welcome to the team, Eliot. excited to pair on infra stuff soon.

Casey Li: added you to payroll, benefits doc link, and scheduled 1:1s. ping if badge still missing tomorrow.

Eliot Tran: thanks everyone! see you friday. <:party_parrot:>
